from f.db.mongodb import init_mongodb, close_mongodb
from f.dna.models import DnaMovie,DnaTv
from f.dna.generate.spend_pause import SpendPause,PAUSE_KEY
import wmill,requests

def main():
 init_mongodb()
 output=[]
 for cls,ids in [(DnaMovie,[603,550,545611,1233066,150540]),(DnaTv,[1396,1399,249042,42009,64230])]:
  for e in cls.objects(tmdb_id__in=ids):
   output.append({'id':str(e.id),'type':'movie' if cls==DnaMovie else 'tv','tmdb_id':e.tmdb_id,'title':e.original_title,'popularity':e.popularity,'overview':e.overview,'release_year':e.release_year,'is_selected':e.is_selected,'selected_at':str(e.selected_at),'llm_model_name':e.llm_model_name,'dna':e.dna,'vector_essence_length':len(e.vector_essence_text or []),'vector_fingerprint_length':len(e.vector_fingerprint or [])})
 close_mongodb()
 pause=SpendPause(); active=pause.is_active()
 key=wmill.get_variable('u/Alp/OPENROUTER_API_KEY')
 r=requests.get('https://openrouter.ai/api/v1/key',headers={'Authorization':'Bearer '+key},timeout=20);r.raise_for_status();k=r.json()['data']
 return {'titles':output,'pause_active':active,'pause_ttl':pause.redis.ttl(PAUSE_KEY),'key':{k1:k.get(k1) for k1 in ['limit','limit_reset','limit_remaining','usage','usage_daily','usage_monthly']}}
